rule: Owner, Round 18: a career whose Class 12 rule is 'any stream' but whose usual routes include a degree that needs particular subjects (B.Tech: Physics, Chemistry and Maths; MBBS/BDS/nursing: Physics, Chemistry and Biology; B.Pharm: Physics and Chemistry with Biology or Maths) shows the subjects PER ROUTE, so 'Any stream' never hides the stream a common route needs. Covers every such career and every 'degree is common, not required' career (degree_dependency undergrad + mid_stream_entry open). Display only; matching never reads this file — eligibility stays class12_prerequisite.
